## Current Work

Brian works on product, strategy, foresight, organizational change, and small software. He leads Future of Home work at Lowe's Innovation Labs and writes at Little Futures.

## Background

- Lead, Future of Home group at Lowe's Innovation Labs
- Led Tachyon Accelerator at ConsenSys Labs
- Worked on the revenue side at Quartz, helping launch Quartz Creative
- Partner at GMD studios, a ventures and innovation firm
